REAL AUDIO REACTIVITY

Choose an audio file from your device. Bass energy drives the action-game visuals. In Lost Frequencies it also powers your shots and charges your shield. The file stays on your device. Pause Bandcamp first to avoid playing both.

VISUAL RHYTHM MODE

Eight original games inspired by arcade classics. No sound effects or autoplay—just your music and a little cosmic interference. Progress and high scores are saved in this browser when storage is available.
